inputs: current velocity and six past command taps; no future commands
update_order: predict and score, then assimilate next observation
posterior: linear Gaussian residual coefficients; forgetting covariance optional
selection: validation standardized MSE for adaptation; validation NLL for calibration
controls: identical posterior mean with fixed Gaussian/Student-t variance; fixed ARX; EWMA
scope: predictive diagnostic only; not proof of physical delay or navigation gain
